name: Allison Transmission Holdings, Inc.
summary:
Allison Transmission (ALSN) reported earnings of $2.73 per share on revenue of $1.57 billion for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $2.60 per share on revenue of $1.51 billion. The company beat consensus estimates by 5.00% while revenue grew 92.38% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects 2026 revenue of $5.80 billion to $6.00 billion. The company's previous guidance was revenue of $5.575 billion to $5.925 billion, and the current consensus revenue estimate is $5.79 billion for the year ending December 31, 2026.

Allison Transmission Holdings Inc is a manufacturer of fully-automatic transmissions for medium- and heavy-duty commercial vehicles and medium- and heavy-tactical U.S. defense vehicles.
subject: Allison Transmission Beat Consensus Estimates
